events.text: Ajit Rudra was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 20 October 1896 – 3 November 1993

events.text: Ajit Rudra died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 20 October 1896 – 3 November 1993

events.text: Rudra was selected for OTC at Inns of court.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1918 , he was selected for OTC at Inns of court

events.text: Rudra joined the first batch of the Kings Commissioned Indian Officers (KCIOs) at the Daly College in Indore.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1919 , he joined the first batch of the Kings Commissioned Indian Officers ( KCIOs ) at the Daly College in Indore

events.text: Rudra was commissioned into the 28th Punjabis as a temporary second lieutenant in the British Indian Army.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 December 1919 , Rudra was commissioned into the 28th Punjabis as a temporary second lieutenant

events.text: Rudra was appointed to a permanent commission as a second lieutenant.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 17 July 1920 , he was appointed to a permanent commission as a second lieutenant

events.text: Rudra was promoted to temporary lieutenant.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Promoted to temporary lieutenant on 1 December 1920

events.text: Rudra received promotion to the substantive rank of lieutenant.
events.subject: self
events.quote: receiving promotion to the substantive rank of lieutenant on 17

events.text: Rudra was promoted to captain.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Rudra was promoted to captain on 17 October 1927

events.text: Rudra was promoted to major.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was promoted to major on 27 March 1939

events.text: Rudra took part in the Arakan Campaign.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he took part in the Arakan Campaign 1942–43

events.text: Rudra was promoted to acting lieutenant-colonel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was promoted to acting lieutenant-colonel on 15 June 1943

events.text: Rudra was promoted to temporary lieutenant-colonel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: to temporary lieutenant-colonel on 14 September 1943

events.text: Lieutenant Colonel Rudra was transferred to the General Staff at GHQ India by General Claude Auchinleck.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1943 , Lieutenant Colonel Rudra was transferred to the General Staff at GHQ India

events.text: Rudra was promoted to acting colonel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was promoted to acting colonel on 3 April 1945

events.text: Rudra was further promoted to temporary colonel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was further promoted to temporary colonel on 3 October 1945

events.text: Rudra was promoted to acting brigadier.
events.subject: self
events.quote: to acting brigadier on 27 March 1946

events.text: Rudra was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire (Military Division).
events.subject: self
events.quote: In June 1946 , Rudra was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire ( Military Division )

events.text: Rudra was promoted to the substantive rank of lieutenant-colonel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 17 July 1946 , by then a temporary brigadier and Director of Morale , GHQ

events.text: Brigadier Rudra was serving as the Military Secretary at GHQ.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1948 , the year after India gained its independence , Brigadier Rudra was serving as the Military Secretary at GHQ

events.text: Rudra was promoted to substantive major-general.
events.subject: self
events.quote: with promotion to substantive major-general on 1 January 1950

events.text: Rudra retired.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was appointed General Officer Commanding , Southern Command and retired in 1959

events.text: Palit, Major General D.K. published Major General A.A. Rudra, His Service in Three Armies and Two World Wars.
